;International relations
*[[Crisis in Venezuela (2012–present)]], [[Colombia–Venezuela relations]] 
**Newly inaugurated [[Colombia]]n [[President of Colombia|President]] [[Iván Duque Márquez]] announces that he will not have an ambassador in neighboring [[Venezuela]]. [https://www.diariolasamericas.com/america-latina/ivan-duque-asume-la-presidencia-incertidumbre-interna-y-tension-venezuela-n4159504 (''Diarios Las Américas'')]

*[[2018 China–United States trade war]]
**The [[Office of the United States Trade Representative]] publishes its finalized list of 279 Chinese goods, worth [[USD|$]]16 billion, to be subject to a 25% [[tariff]] from August 23. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-china/u-s-finalizes-next-china-tariff-list-targeting-16-billion-in-imports-idUSKBN1KS2CB (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Crime in Germany]]
**A [[Germany|German]] couple is jailed for twelve years each for selling the woman's son to a [[Spain|Spanish]] pedophile on the [[dark web]], who repeatedly abused him. The couple themselves previously abused the boy and a three-year-old girl, whom they are ordered to pay [[€]]42,500 in compensation. The Spaniard is sentenced to ten years. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-45096183 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Ohio's 12th congressional district special election, 2018]]
**A special election for [[Ohio]]'s 12th congressional district is held following the resignation of Republican [[United States House of Representatives|Representative]] [[Pat Tiberi]]. The [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] candidate is [[Troy Balderson]] and the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] candidate is [[Danny O'Connor (Ohio politician)|Danny O'Connor]]. [https://www.politico.com/story/2018/08/07/ohio-special-election-primary-midterms-765055 (''Politico'')]
*[[Politics of Colombia]] 
**[[Iván Duque Márquez]] is sworn in as new [[President of Colombia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-45107063 (BBC News)]
*[[Arrest of Juan Requesens]], [[Caracas drone explosions]]
**Venezuelan politician [[Juan Requesens]] is arrested for alleged crimes related to the supposed Maduro assassination attempt, despite having political immunity. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-45112582 (BBC News)]
